ko.title: 100건의 사건, 하나의 명부: 마이애미 이민 법원을 압도하는 "메가 마스터" 심리 내부

segments.src: ## A Courthouse Under Strain
segments.tr: ## 부담을 안고 있는 법원

segments.src: Before sunrise on weekday mornings, lines now stretch outside the Miami immigration courthouse, with families and individuals waiting for hours just to check in for a hearing.
segments.tr: 평일 아침 해가 뜨기 전, 마이애미 이민 법원 밖에는 이제 줄이 길게 늘어서 있으며, 가족과 개인들이 심리를 위해 단순히 출석 확인을 하려고 몇 시간씩 기다리고 있습니다.

segments.src: Attorneys and court observers say the wait has become a routine part of navigating the system here, driven by a scheduling approach some in the legal community have nicknamed the "mega master" docket: dozens, and in some instances more than 100, individual cases assigned to a single judge on a single day.
segments.tr: 변호사들과 법원 참관인들은 이러한 대기가 이곳의 시스템을 이용하는 과정에서 일상적인 부분이 되었다고 말하며, 이는 법조계 일부에서 "메가 마스터(mega master)" 명부라고 부르는 일정 관리 방식 때문이라고 지적합니다. 즉, 하루에 한 명의 판사에게 수십 건, 때로는 100건이 넘는 개별 사건이 배정되는 것입니다.

segments.src: Master calendar hearings are typically brief, administrative sessions where a judge confirms basic case information, addresses filing deadlines, and schedules the next stage of proceedings.
segments.tr: 마스터 캘린더(Master calendar) 심리는 일반적으로 판사가 기본적인 사건 정보를 확인하고, 서류 제출 기한을 다루며, 다음 절차를 예약하는 짧은 행정적 세션입니다.

segments.src: They are not meant to resolve a case, but they are a required checkpoint in it.
segments.tr: 이 심리는 사건을 해결하기 위한 것이 아니라, 사건 진행 과정에서 필수적인 검문소와 같은 역할을 합니다.

segments.src: When that checkpoint is stretched across a docket of 100-plus names, the math becomes difficult: even a few minutes per case, multiplied many times over, can push a single day's calendar well past standard court hours.
segments.tr: 그 검문소가 100개가 넘는 이름이 적힌 명부에 걸쳐 늘어지면, 계산은 복잡해집니다. 사건당 몇 분만 소요되더라도, 그것이 여러 번 곱해지면 하루의 일정이 표준 법원 운영 시간을 훨씬 넘어서게 될 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why the Dockets Have Grown
segments.tr: ## 명부가 늘어난 이유

segments.src: Immigration courts nationwide have faced a mounting backlog of pending cases for years, a trend that predates any single administration and reflects a system that has long struggled to match staffing and courtroom capacity to caseload growth.
segments.tr: 전국의 이민 법원들은 수년 동안 계류 중인 사건의 적체가 쌓이는 문제에 직면해 왔으며, 이는 특정 행정부 이전부터 시작된 추세로, 인력과 법정 수용 능력을 사건 증가 속도에 맞추기 위해 오랫동안 고군분투해 온 시스템을 반영합니다.

segments.src: Court administrators have described consolidated, high-volume dockets as one tool for moving cases forward more quickly and reducing the overall backlog.
segments.tr: 법원 관리자들은 통합된 대규모 명부가 사건을 더 빠르게 진행하고 전반적인 적체를 줄이기 위한 하나의 도구라고 설명해 왔습니다.

segments.src: Immigration attorneys, however, say the practical effect can cut the other way.
segments.tr: 그러나 이민 전문 변호사들은 실제 효과는 정반대일 수 있다고 말합니다.

segments.src: With so many cases packed into one day, hearings are often rescheduled, delayed, or rushed, and it becomes harder for respondents — many of whom are unrepresented — to track exactly when their case will be called.
segments.tr: 하루에 너무 많은 사건이 몰리면서 심리가 자주 재조정되거나 지연되거나 서둘러 진행되며, 대리인이 없는 경우가 많은 피신청인들은 자신의 사건이 정확히 언제 호출될지 파악하기가 더 어려워집니다.

segments.src: Some attorneys report being assigned to appear for multiple clients scheduled at nearly the same time, forcing difficult choices about which hearing to prioritize.
segments.tr: 일부 변호사들은 거의 같은 시간에 예정된 여러 의뢰인을 위해 출석해야 하는 상황을 보고하며, 어떤 심리를 우선시해야 할지 어려운 선택을 강요받고 있다고 전합니다.

segments.src: ## The Link to In-Absentia Orders
segments.tr: ## 궐석 판결과의 연관성

segments.src: One consequence that has drawn particular attention is a rise in in-absentia deportation orders — rulings issued when a respondent does not appear for a scheduled hearing.
segments.tr: 특히 주목을 받고 있는 결과 중 하나는 궐석 추방 명령(in-absentia deportation orders)의 증가입니다. 이는 피신청인이 예정된 심리에 출석하지 않았을 때 내려지는 판결입니다.

segments.src: Nationally, these orders have reportedly climbed to among the highest levels on record in recent court data reviewed by legal aid organizations.
segments.tr: 법률 구조 단체들이 검토한 최근 법원 데이터에 따르면, 전국적으로 이러한 명령은 기록상 최고 수준에 도달한 것으로 보고되었습니다.

segments.src: Advocates argue that confusing notices, long courthouse lines, overcrowded dockets, and limited access to counsel can all contribute to missed hearings, particularly for people who are not fluent in English or lack reliable transportation and childcare.
segments.tr: 옹호자들은 혼란스러운 통지서, 긴 법원 대기 줄, 과밀한 명부, 변호인에 대한 제한된 접근성 등이 모두 심리 불참의 원인이 될 수 있다고 주장하며, 특히 영어가 유창하지 않거나 신뢰할 수 있는 교통편과 보육 수단이 부족한 사람들에게 이러한 문제가 더 크게 작용한다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: Immigration law generally allows a judge to order removal in a person's absence if proper notice was given, and reopening such a case typically requires showing the absence was due to "exceptional circumstances."
segments.tr: 이민법은 일반적으로 적절한 통지가 이루어졌다면 판사가 피신청인의 부재 시 추방을 명령할 수 있도록 허용하며, 그러한 사건을 재개하려면 일반적으로 부재가 "예외적인 상황(exceptional circumstances)" 때문이었음을 입증해야 합니다.

segments.src: Attorneys note that the bar for reopening can be difficult to meet, which raises the stakes of any hearing that goes uncalled or unattended due to scheduling congestion.
segments.tr: 변호사들은 사건 재개를 위한 기준을 충족하기가 어려울 수 있으며, 이로 인해 일정 혼잡으로 인해 호출되지 않거나 참석하지 못한 모든 심리의 중요성이 더욱 커진다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: ## Life Outside the Courthouse
segments.tr: ## 법원 밖의 삶

segments.src: For many families, the burden begins well before a case is called.
segments.tr: 많은 가족에게 부담은 사건이 호출되기 훨씬 전부터 시작됩니다.

segments.src: Waiting in line for hours, arranging time off work, and finding care for children are all part of a single hearing day — one that, under a packed docket, may end without a case being reached at all, requiring a return trip on another date.
segments.tr: 몇 시간씩 줄을 서서 기다리고, 직장에서 시간을 내고, 아이들을 돌볼 사람을 찾는 것은 모두 단 하루의 심리를 위한 과정의 일부입니다. 빽빽한 명부 아래에서는 사건이 다뤄지지도 않은 채 하루가 끝날 수도 있으며, 이 경우 다른 날에 다시 방문해야 합니다.

segments.src: Local legal aid groups say they have expanded morning outreach and know-your-rights information to help people understand check-in procedures and reduce the chance of an avoidable missed hearing.
segments.tr: 지역 법률 구조 단체들은 사람들이 출석 확인 절차를 이해하고 피할 수 있는 심리 불참 가능성을 줄일 수 있도록 아침 아웃리치 활동과 권리 안내 정보를 확대했다고 말합니다.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 앞으로의 전망

segments.src: Court officials have not detailed specific plans to cap the size of individual dockets, and the practice appears to reflect broader capacity pressures across the immigration court system rather than a policy unique to South Florida.
segments.tr: 법원 관계자들은 개별 명부의 규모를 제한하기 위한 구체적인 계획을 밝히지 않았으며, 이러한 관행은 사우스 플로리다만의 독특한 정책이라기보다는 이민 법원 시스템 전반에 걸친 더 광범위한 수용 능력 압박을 반영하는 것으로 보입니다.

segments.src: Legal observers say the situation in Miami is likely to be watched closely as a bellwether for how the courts balance the competing goals of reducing case backlogs and preserving each respondent's opportunity to be heard.
segments.tr: 법률 참관인들은 마이애미의 상황이 법원이 사건 적체 감소와 각 피신청인의 소명 기회 보장이라는 상충하는 목표를 어떻게 균형 있게 조정하는지를 보여주는 지표로서 면밀히 관찰될 가능성이 높다고 말합니다.

segments.src: *This report is based on publicly available court information and accounts from immigration attorneys and legal aid organizations.
segments.tr: *이 보고서는 공개된 법원 정보와 이민 전문 변호사 및 법률 구조 단체의 설명을 바탕으로 작성되었습니다.

segments.src: Individual case outcomes vary, and readers with a pending immigration matter should consult a qualified attorney or accredited representative for guidance specific to their situation.*
segments.tr: 개별 사건의 결과는 다를 수 있으며, 계류 중인 이민 문제를 가진 독자는 자신의 상황에 맞는 구체적인 지침을 얻기 위해 자격을 갖춘 변호사나 공인 대리인과 상담해야 합니다.*

zh.title: 100起案件，一个日程表：直击不堪重负的迈阿密移民法庭“超级主日程”听证会

segments.src: ## A Courthouse Under Strain
segments.tr: ## 不堪重负的法庭

segments.src: Before sunrise on weekday mornings, lines now stretch outside the Miami immigration courthouse, with families and individuals waiting for hours just to check in for a hearing.
segments.tr: 在工作日清晨太阳升起之前，迈阿密移民法庭外就已经排起了长队，许多家庭和个人要等待数小时才能办理听证会登记。

segments.src: Attorneys and court observers say the wait has become a routine part of navigating the system here, driven by a scheduling approach some in the legal community have nicknamed the "mega master" docket: dozens, and in some instances more than 100, individual cases assigned to a single judge on a single day.
segments.tr: 律师和法庭观察员表示，在这里，排队等待已成为应对该系统的常态，这主要是由一种被法律界部分人士戏称为“超级主日程”（mega master）的排程方式所导致的：在同一天内，一名法官会被分配几十起、甚至在某些情况下超过100起个人案件。

segments.src: Master calendar hearings are typically brief, administrative sessions where a judge confirms basic case information, addresses filing deadlines, and schedules the next stage of proceedings.
segments.tr: 主日程听证会（Master calendar hearings）通常是简短的行政会议，法官在会上确认基本的案件信息、处理提交截止日期，并安排下一阶段的诉讼程序。

segments.src: They are not meant to resolve a case, but they are a required checkpoint in it.
segments.tr: 这些听证会并非为了解决案件，但它们是案件中必不可少的检查点。

segments.src: When that checkpoint is stretched across a docket of 100-plus names, the math becomes difficult: even a few minutes per case, multiplied many times over, can push a single day's calendar well past standard court hours.
segments.tr: 当这个检查点被拉长到包含100多个名字的日程表上时，时间计算就变得困难了：即使每个案件只花几分钟，乘以许多倍后，也会使单日的日程远远超出标准的法庭工作时间。

segments.src: ## Why the Dockets Have Grown
segments.tr: ## 为什么日程表会膨胀

segments.src: Immigration courts nationwide have faced a mounting backlog of pending cases for years, a trend that predates any single administration and reflects a system that has long struggled to match staffing and courtroom capacity to caseload growth.
segments.tr: 多年来，全国范围内的移民法庭都面临着积压案件不断增加的问题，这一趋势早于任何单一届政府，反映出该系统长期以来难以使人员配备和法庭容量跟上案件量的增长。

segments.src: Court administrators have described consolidated, high-volume dockets as one tool for moving cases forward more quickly and reducing the overall backlog.
segments.tr: 法庭管理人员将合并的、高容量的日程表描述为更快推进案件和减少整体积压的一种工具。

segments.src: Immigration attorneys, however, say the practical effect can cut the other way.
segments.tr: 然而，移民律师表示，实际效果可能会适得其反。

segments.src: With so many cases packed into one day, hearings are often rescheduled, delayed, or rushed, and it becomes harder for respondents — many of whom are unrepresented — to track exactly when their case will be called.
segments.tr: 由于一天内挤满了如此多的案件，听证会经常被重新安排、推迟或匆忙进行，这使得当事人（其中许多人没有律师代表）更难准确追踪自己的案件何时会被点名。

segments.src: Some attorneys report being assigned to appear for multiple clients scheduled at nearly the same time, forcing difficult choices about which hearing to prioritize.
segments.tr: 一些律师报告称，他们被指派为几乎在同一时间安排的多个客户出庭，这迫使他们不得不就优先处理哪个听证会做出艰难的选择。

segments.src: ## The Link to In-Absentia Orders
segments.tr: ## 与缺席判决的联系

segments.src: One consequence that has drawn particular attention is a rise in in-absentia deportation orders — rulings issued when a respondent does not appear for a scheduled hearing.
segments.tr: 引起特别关注的一个后果是缺席驱逐令（in-absentia deportation orders）的增加——即在当事人未出席预定听证会时做出的裁决。

segments.src: Nationally, these orders have reportedly climbed to among the highest levels on record in recent court data reviewed by legal aid organizations.
segments.tr: 在全国范围内，根据法律援助机构审查的近期法庭数据，据报道这些判决已攀升至有记录以来的最高水平之一。

segments.src: Advocates argue that confusing notices, long courthouse lines, overcrowded dockets, and limited access to counsel can all contribute to missed hearings, particularly for people who are not fluent in English or lack reliable transportation and childcare.
segments.tr: 倡导者认为，令人困惑的通知、法庭外的长队、过度拥挤的日程表以及获得法律咨询的机会有限，都可能导致错过听证会，特别是对于英语不流利或缺乏可靠交通工具和托儿服务的人来说。

segments.src: Immigration law generally allows a judge to order removal in a person's absence if proper notice was given, and reopening such a case typically requires showing the absence was due to "exceptional circumstances."
segments.tr: 移民法通常允许法官在已给予适当通知的情况下，在当事人缺席时下达驱逐令，而重新审理此类案件通常需要证明缺席是由于“特殊情况”。

segments.src: Attorneys note that the bar for reopening can be difficult to meet, which raises the stakes of any hearing that goes uncalled or unattended due to scheduling congestion.
segments.tr: 律师们指出，重新审理的门槛可能很难达到，这增加了因日程拥堵而未被点名或未出席的任何听证会的风险。

segments.src: ## Life Outside the Courthouse
segments.tr: ## 法庭之外的生活

segments.src: For many families, the burden begins well before a case is called.
segments.tr: 对于许多家庭来说，负担在案件被点名之前很久就开始了。

segments.src: Waiting in line for hours, arranging time off work, and finding care for children are all part of a single hearing day — one that, under a packed docket, may end without a case being reached at all, requiring a return trip on another date.
segments.tr: 排队等候数小时、安排请假以及寻找人照顾孩子，都是单个听证会日的一部分——在拥挤的日程表下，这一天可能会在根本没有轮到案件的情况下结束，从而需要另择日期再次前往。

segments.src: Local legal aid groups say they have expanded morning outreach and know-your-rights information to help people understand check-in procedures and reduce the chance of an avoidable missed hearing.
segments.tr: 当地法律援助团体表示，他们已经扩大了早间的宣传活动并提供“了解你的权利”信息，以帮助人们了解登记程序，并减少因疏忽而错过听证会的可能性。

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## 下一步是什么

segments.src: Court officials have not detailed specific plans to cap the size of individual dockets, and the practice appears to reflect broader capacity pressures across the immigration court system rather than a policy unique to South Florida.
segments.tr: 法庭官员尚未详细说明限制单个日程表规模的具体计划，这种做法似乎反映了整个移民法庭系统面临的更广泛的容量压力，而不是南佛罗里达州特有的政策。

segments.src: Legal observers say the situation in Miami is likely to be watched closely as a bellwether for how the courts balance the competing goals of reducing case backlogs and preserving each respondent's opportunity to be heard.
segments.tr: 法律观察员表示，迈阿密的情况可能会被密切关注，以此作为评估法庭如何在减少案件积压和保留每位当事人申辩机会这两个相互竞争的目标之间取得平衡的风向标。

segments.src: *This report is based on publicly available court information and accounts from immigration attorneys and legal aid organizations.
segments.tr: *本报告基于公开的法庭信息以及移民律师和法律援助机构的陈述。

segments.src: Individual case outcomes vary, and readers with a pending immigration matter should consult a qualified attorney or accredited representative for guidance specific to their situation.*
segments.tr: 个案结果会有所不同，有未决移民事务的读者应咨询合格的律师或认可的代表，以获得针对其具体情况的指导。*

segments.tr: ## तनाव में एक न्यायालय

segments.tr: सप्ताह के दिनों में सूर्योदय से पहले ही, मियामी आव्रजन न्यायालय के बाहर लंबी कतारें लग जाती हैं, जहाँ परिवार और व्यक्ति केवल सुनवाई के लिए चेक-इन करने के लिए घंटों इंतजार करते हैं।

segments.src: Attorneys and court observers say the wait has become a routine part of navigating the system here, driven by a scheduling approach some in the legal community have nicknamed the "mega master" docket: dozens, and in some instances more than 100, individual cases assigned to a single judge on a single day.
segments.tr: वकीलों और अदालती पर्यवेक्षकों का कहना है कि यहाँ की प्रणाली में आगे बढ़ने के लिए यह प्रतीक्षा एक नियमित हिस्सा बन गई है, जिसका कारण एक शेड्यूलिंग दृष्टिकोण है जिसे कानूनी समुदाय में कुछ लोगों ने "मेगा मास्टर" डॉकेट का उपनाम दिया है: एक ही दिन में एक ही न्यायाधीश को दर्जनों, और कुछ मामलों में 100 से अधिक व्यक्तिगत मामले सौंपे जाना।

segments.src: Master calendar hearings are typically brief, administrative sessions where a judge confirms basic case information, addresses filing deadlines, and schedules the next stage of proceedings.
segments.tr: मास्टर कैलेंडर सुनवाई आम तौर पर संक्षिप्त, प्रशासनिक सत्र होते हैं जहाँ एक न्यायाधीश बुनियादी मामले की जानकारी की पुष्टि करता है, फाइलिंग की समय-सीमा को संबोधित करता है, और कार्यवाही के अगले चरण को निर्धारित करता है।

segments.src: They are not meant to resolve a case, but they are a required checkpoint in it.
segments.tr: इनका उद्देश्य किसी मामले को हल करना नहीं होता है, लेकिन ये उसमें एक आवश्यक चेकपॉइंट होते हैं।

segments.src: When that checkpoint is stretched across a docket of 100-plus names, the math becomes difficult: even a few minutes per case, multiplied many times over, can push a single day's calendar well past standard court hours.
segments.tr: जब उस चेकपॉइंट को 100 से अधिक नामों के डॉकेट पर फैलाया जाता है, तो गणित कठिन हो जाता है: प्रति मामले में कुछ मिनट भी, कई बार गुणा करने पर, एक दिन के कैलेंडर को मानक अदालती घंटों से काफी आगे बढ़ा सकते हैं।

segments.src: ## Why the Dockets Have Grown
segments.tr: ## डॉकेट क्यों बढ़ गए हैं

segments.src: Immigration courts nationwide have faced a mounting backlog of pending cases for years, a trend that predates any single administration and reflects a system that has long struggled to match staffing and courtroom capacity to caseload growth.
segments.tr: देश भर के आव्रजन न्यायालयों को वर्षों से लंबित मामलों के बढ़ते बैकलॉग का सामना करना पड़ रहा है, यह एक ऐसी प्रवृत्ति है जो किसी एक प्रशासन से पहले की है और एक ऐसी प्रणाली को दर्शाती है जो लंबे समय से स्टाफ और अदालती क्षमता को मामलों की संख्या में वृद्धि के साथ मिलाने के लिए संघर्ष कर रही है।

segments.src: Court administrators have described consolidated, high-volume dockets as one tool for moving cases forward more quickly and reducing the overall backlog.
segments.tr: अदालती प्रशासकों ने समेकित, उच्च-मात्रा वाले डॉकेटों को मामलों को तेजी से आगे बढ़ाने और समग्र बैकलॉग को कम करने के एक उपकरण के रूप में वर्णित किया है।

segments.src: Immigration attorneys, however, say the practical effect can cut the other way.
segments.tr: हालाँकि, आव्रजन वकीलों का कहना है कि इसका व्यावहारिक प्रभाव इसके विपरीत हो सकता है।

segments.src: With so many cases packed into one day, hearings are often rescheduled, delayed, or rushed, and it becomes harder for respondents — many of whom are unrepresented — to track exactly when their case will be called.
segments.tr: एक ही दिन में इतने सारे मामलों के होने से, सुनवाई अक्सर पुनर्निर्धारित, विलंबित या जल्दबाजी में की जाती है, और प्रतिवादियों के लिए — जिनमें से कई का कोई प्रतिनिधित्व नहीं होता है — यह ट्रैक करना कठिन हो जाता है कि उनके मामले की सुनवाई वास्तव में कब की जाएगी।

segments.src: Some attorneys report being assigned to appear for multiple clients scheduled at nearly the same time, forcing difficult choices about which hearing to prioritize.
segments.tr: कुछ वकील रिपोर्ट करते हैं कि उन्हें लगभग एक ही समय पर निर्धारित कई ग्राहकों के लिए उपस्थित होने का काम सौंपा जाता है, जिससे उन्हें यह चुनने में कठिन निर्णय लेने पड़ते हैं कि किस सुनवाई को प्राथमिकता दी जाए।

segments.src: ## The Link to In-Absentia Orders
segments.tr: ## अनुपस्थिति में आदेशों से संबंध

segments.src: One consequence that has drawn particular attention is a rise in in-absentia deportation orders — rulings issued when a respondent does not appear for a scheduled hearing.
segments.tr: एक परिणाम जिसने विशेष ध्यान आकर्षित किया है, वह है अनुपस्थिति में निर्वासन आदेशों (in-absentia deportation orders) में वृद्धि — ये वे निर्णय हैं जो तब जारी किए जाते हैं जब कोई प्रतिवादी निर्धारित सुनवाई के लिए उपस्थित नहीं होता है।

segments.src: Nationally, these orders have reportedly climbed to among the highest levels on record in recent court data reviewed by legal aid organizations.
segments.tr: राष्ट्रीय स्तर पर, कानूनी सहायता संगठनों द्वारा समीक्षा किए गए हालिया अदालती आंकड़ों में ये आदेश कथित तौर पर रिकॉर्ड पर उच्चतम स्तरों में से एक पर पहुंच गए हैं।

segments.src: Advocates argue that confusing notices, long courthouse lines, overcrowded dockets, and limited access to counsel can all contribute to missed hearings, particularly for people who are not fluent in English or lack reliable transportation and childcare.
segments.tr: अधिवक्ताओं का तर्क है कि भ्रमित करने वाले नोटिस, लंबी अदालती कतारें, भीड़भाड़ वाले डॉकेट और वकील तक सीमित पहुंच, ये सभी सुनवाई छूटने में योगदान दे सकते हैं, विशेष रूप से उन लोगों के लिए जो अंग्रेजी में पारंगत नहीं हैं या जिनके पास विश्वसनीय परिवहन और बाल देखभाल की कमी है।

segments.src: Immigration law generally allows a judge to order removal in a person's absence if proper notice was given, and reopening such a case typically requires showing the absence was due to "exceptional circumstances."
segments.tr: आव्रजन कानून आम तौर पर एक न्यायाधीश को किसी व्यक्ति की अनुपस्थिति में निष्कासन का आदेश देने की अनुमति देता है यदि उचित नोटिस दिया गया था, और ऐसे मामले को फिर से खोलने के लिए आमतौर पर यह दिखाना आवश्यक होता है कि अनुपस्थिति "असाधारण परिस्थितियों" के कारण थी।

segments.src: Attorneys note that the bar for reopening can be difficult to meet, which raises the stakes of any hearing that goes uncalled or unattended due to scheduling congestion.
segments.tr: वकील ध्यान दिलाते हैं कि फिर से खोलने की सीमा को पूरा करना कठिन हो सकता है, जो शेड्यूलिंग की भीड़ के कारण बिना सुनवाई या बिना उपस्थिति के छूट जाने वाली किसी भी सुनवाई के जोखिम को बढ़ा देता है।

segments.src: ## Life Outside the Courthouse
segments.tr: ## न्यायालय के बाहर का जीवन

segments.src: For many families, the burden begins well before a case is called.
segments.tr: कई परिवारों के लिए, यह बोझ मामले की सुनवाई शुरू होने से बहुत पहले ही शुरू हो जाता है।

segments.src: Waiting in line for hours, arranging time off work, and finding care for children are all part of a single hearing day — one that, under a packed docket, may end without a case being reached at all, requiring a return trip on another date.
segments.tr: घंटों कतार में इंतजार करना, काम से छुट्टी की व्यवस्था करना और बच्चों की देखभाल का प्रबंध करना, ये सभी एक ही सुनवाई के दिन का हिस्सा हैं — जो कि एक भरे हुए डॉकेट के तहत, बिना किसी सुनवाई के समाप्त हो सकता है, जिसके लिए किसी अन्य तारीख पर फिर से यात्रा करनी पड़ती है।

segments.src: Local legal aid groups say they have expanded morning outreach and know-your-rights information to help people understand check-in procedures and reduce the chance of an avoidable missed hearing.
segments.tr: स्थानीय कानूनी सहायता समूहों का कहना है कि उन्होंने लोगों को चेक-इन प्रक्रियाओं को समझने और टालने योग्य सुनवाई छूटने की संभावना को कम करने में मदद करने के लिए सुबह के आउटरीच और अधिकारों की जानकारी देने के काम का विस्तार किया है।

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## आगे क्या होगा

segments.src: Court officials have not detailed specific plans to cap the size of individual dockets, and the practice appears to reflect broader capacity pressures across the immigration court system rather than a policy unique to South Florida.
segments.tr: अदालती अधिकारियों ने व्यक्तिगत डॉकेट के आकार को सीमित करने की विशिष्ट योजनाओं का विवरण नहीं दिया है, और यह प्रथा दक्षिण फ्लोरिडा के लिए अद्वितीय नीति के बजाय पूरे आव्रजन न्यायालय प्रणाली में व्यापक क्षमता के दबावों को दर्शाती प्रतीत होती है।

segments.src: Legal observers say the situation in Miami is likely to be watched closely as a bellwether for how the courts balance the competing goals of reducing case backlogs and preserving each respondent's opportunity to be heard.
segments.tr: कानूनी पर्यवेक्षकों का कहना है कि मियामी की स्थिति पर बारीकी से नज़र रखे जाने की संभावना है, जो इस बात का सूचक होगी कि अदालतें मामलों के बैकलॉग को कम करने और प्रत्येक प्रतिवादी की बात सुने जाने के अवसर को सुरक्षित रखने के प्रतिस्पर्धी लक्ष्यों को कैसे संतुलित करती हैं।

segments.src: *This report is based on publicly available court information and accounts from immigration attorneys and legal aid organizations.
segments.tr: *यह रिपोर्ट सार्वजनिक रूप से उपलब्ध अदालती जानकारी और आव्रजन वकीलों तथा कानूनी सहायता संगठनों के विवरणों पर आधारित है।

segments.src: Individual case outcomes vary, and readers with a pending immigration matter should consult a qualified attorney or accredited representative for guidance specific to their situation.*
segments.tr: व्यक्तिगत मामलों के परिणाम भिन्न होते हैं, और लंबित आव्रजन मामले वाले पाठकों को अपनी स्थिति के विशिष्ट मार्गदर्शन के लिए किसी योग्य वकील या मान्यता प्राप्त प्रतिनिधि से परामर्श करना चाहिए।*

es.title: 100 casos, un expediente: dentro de las audiencias "mega master" que abruman al tribunal de inmigración de Miami

segments.src: ## A Courthouse Under Strain
segments.tr: ## Un tribunal bajo presión

segments.src: Before sunrise on weekday mornings, lines now stretch outside the Miami immigration courthouse, with families and individuals waiting for hours just to check in for a hearing.
segments.tr: Antes del amanecer, en las mañanas de días laborables, las filas ahora se extienden fuera del tribunal de inmigración de Miami, con familias y personas esperando durante horas solo para registrarse para una audiencia.

segments.src: Attorneys and court observers say the wait has become a routine part of navigating the system here, driven by a scheduling approach some in the legal community have nicknamed the "mega master" docket: dozens, and in some instances more than 100, individual cases assigned to a single judge on a single day.
segments.tr: Los abogados y observadores judiciales dicen que la espera se ha convertido en una parte rutinaria de navegar el sistema aquí, impulsada por un enfoque de programación que algunos en la comunidad legal han apodado el expediente "mega master": docenas, y en algunos casos más de 100, casos individuales asignados a un solo juez en un solo día.

segments.src: Master calendar hearings are typically brief, administrative sessions where a judge confirms basic case information, addresses filing deadlines, and schedules the next stage of proceedings.
segments.tr: Las audiencias del calendario maestro son típicamente sesiones administrativas breves donde un juez confirma la información básica del caso, aborda los plazos de presentación y programa la siguiente etapa de los procedimientos.

segments.src: They are not meant to resolve a case, but they are a required checkpoint in it.
segments.tr: No están destinadas a resolver un caso, pero son un punto de control requerido en el mismo.

segments.src: When that checkpoint is stretched across a docket of 100-plus names, the math becomes difficult: even a few minutes per case, multiplied many times over, can push a single day's calendar well past standard court hours.
segments.tr: Cuando ese punto de control se extiende a través de un expediente de más de 100 nombres, la matemática se vuelve difícil: incluso unos pocos minutos por caso, multiplicados muchas veces, pueden empujar el calendario de un solo día mucho más allá del horario judicial estándar.

segments.src: ## Why the Dockets Have Grown
segments.tr: ## Por qué han crecido los expedientes

segments.src: Immigration courts nationwide have faced a mounting backlog of pending cases for years, a trend that predates any single administration and reflects a system that has long struggled to match staffing and courtroom capacity to caseload growth.
segments.tr: Los tribunales de inmigración de todo el país han enfrentado una creciente acumulación de casos pendientes durante años, una tendencia que es anterior a cualquier administración y refleja un sistema que ha luchado durante mucho tiempo para igualar la dotación de personal y la capacidad de la sala del tribunal con el crecimiento de la carga de casos.

segments.src: Court administrators have described consolidated, high-volume dockets as one tool for moving cases forward more quickly and reducing the overall backlog.
segments.tr: Los administradores judiciales han descrito los expedientes consolidados de alto volumen como una herramienta para avanzar los casos más rápidamente y reducir la acumulación general.

segments.src: Immigration attorneys, however, say the practical effect can cut the other way.
segments.tr: Los abogados de inmigración, sin embargo, dicen que el efecto práctico puede ser el contrario.

segments.src: With so many cases packed into one day, hearings are often rescheduled, delayed, or rushed, and it becomes harder for respondents — many of whom are unrepresented — to track exactly when their case will be called.
segments.tr: Con tantos casos acumulados en un solo día, las audiencias a menudo se reprograman, se retrasan o se apresuran, y se vuelve más difícil para los demandados —muchos de los cuales no tienen representación— rastrear exactamente cuándo se llamará a su caso.

segments.src: Some attorneys report being assigned to appear for multiple clients scheduled at nearly the same time, forcing difficult choices about which hearing to prioritize.
segments.tr: Algunos abogados informan que se les asigna comparecer por múltiples clientes programados casi al mismo tiempo, lo que los obliga a tomar decisiones difíciles sobre qué audiencia priorizar.

segments.src: ## The Link to In-Absentia Orders
segments.tr: ## El vínculo con las órdenes en ausencia

segments.src: One consequence that has drawn particular attention is a rise in in-absentia deportation orders — rulings issued when a respondent does not appear for a scheduled hearing.
segments.tr: Una consecuencia que ha llamado especialmente la atención es el aumento de las órdenes de deportación en ausencia (in-absentia): fallos emitidos cuando un demandado no se presenta a una audiencia programada.

segments.src: Nationally, these orders have reportedly climbed to among the highest levels on record in recent court data reviewed by legal aid organizations.
segments.tr: A nivel nacional, estas órdenes han alcanzado, según se informa, uno de los niveles más altos registrados en los datos judiciales recientes revisados por organizaciones de asistencia legal.

segments.src: Advocates argue that confusing notices, long courthouse lines, overcrowded dockets, and limited access to counsel can all contribute to missed hearings, particularly for people who are not fluent in English or lack reliable transportation and childcare.
segments.tr: Los defensores argumentan que los avisos confusos, las largas filas en los tribunales, los expedientes superpoblados y el acceso limitado a un abogado pueden contribuir a que se pierdan las audiencias, particularmente para las personas que no dominan el inglés o carecen de transporte confiable y cuidado infantil.

segments.src: Immigration law generally allows a judge to order removal in a person's absence if proper notice was given, and reopening such a case typically requires showing the absence was due to "exceptional circumstances."
segments.tr: La ley de inmigración generalmente permite que un juez ordene la expulsión en ausencia de una persona si se dio el aviso adecuado, y reabrir un caso de este tipo generalmente requiere demostrar que la ausencia se debió a "circunstancias excepcionales".

segments.src: Attorneys note that the bar for reopening can be difficult to meet, which raises the stakes of any hearing that goes uncalled or unattended due to scheduling congestion.
segments.tr: Los abogados señalan que el listón para la reapertura puede ser difícil de alcanzar, lo que aumenta las apuestas de cualquier audiencia que no sea llamada o a la que no se asista debido a la congestión de la programación.

segments.src: ## Life Outside the Courthouse
segments.tr: ## La vida fuera del tribunal

segments.src: For many families, the burden begins well before a case is called.
segments.tr: Para muchas familias, la carga comienza mucho antes de que se llame a un caso.

segments.src: Waiting in line for hours, arranging time off work, and finding care for children are all part of a single hearing day — one that, under a packed docket, may end without a case being reached at all, requiring a return trip on another date.
segments.tr: Esperar en fila durante horas, organizar el tiempo libre en el trabajo y encontrar cuidado para los niños son parte de un solo día de audiencia; uno que, bajo un expediente lleno, puede terminar sin que se llegue a tratar el caso en absoluto, lo que requiere un viaje de regreso en otra fecha.

segments.src: Local legal aid groups say they have expanded morning outreach and know-your-rights information to help people understand check-in procedures and reduce the chance of an avoidable missed hearing.
segments.tr: Los grupos locales de asistencia legal dicen que han ampliado el alcance matutino y la información sobre "conozca sus derechos" para ayudar a las personas a comprender los procedimientos de registro y reducir la posibilidad de una audiencia perdida evitable.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Qué sigue

segments.src: Court officials have not detailed specific plans to cap the size of individual dockets, and the practice appears to reflect broader capacity pressures across the immigration court system rather than a policy unique to South Florida.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios judiciales no han detallado planes específicos para limitar el tamaño de los expedientes individuales, y la práctica parece reflejar presiones de capacidad más amplias en todo el sistema de tribunales de inmigración en lugar de una política exclusiva del sur de Florida.

segments.src: Legal observers say the situation in Miami is likely to be watched closely as a bellwether for how the courts balance the competing goals of reducing case backlogs and preserving each respondent's opportunity to be heard.
segments.tr: Los observadores legales dicen que es probable que la situación en Miami sea observada de cerca como un indicador de cómo los tribunales equilibran los objetivos contrapuestos de reducir la acumulación de casos y preservar la oportunidad de cada demandado de ser escuchado.

ar.title: 100 قضية، جدول أعمال واحد: نظرة من الداخل على جلسات الاستماع "الضخمة" التي تغمر محكمة الهجرة في ميامي

segments.src: ## A Courthouse Under Strain
segments.tr: ## محكمة تحت الضغط

segments.src: Before sunrise on weekday mornings, lines now stretch outside the Miami immigration courthouse, with families and individuals waiting for hours just to check in for a hearing.
segments.tr: قبل شروق الشمس في أيام الأسبوع، تمتد الطوابير الآن خارج محكمة الهجرة في ميامي، حيث تنتظر العائلات والأفراد لساعات لمجرد تسجيل الحضور لجلسة استماع.

segments.src: Attorneys and court observers say the wait has become a routine part of navigating the system here, driven by a scheduling approach some in the legal community have nicknamed the "mega master" docket: dozens, and in some instances more than 100, individual cases assigned to a single judge on a single day.
segments.tr: يقول المحامون ومراقبو المحكمة إن الانتظار أصبح جزءاً روتينياً من التعامل مع النظام هنا، مدفوعاً بنهج جدولة أطلق عليه البعض في المجتمع القانوني اسم جدول أعمال "الضخم" (mega master): عشرات، وفي بعض الحالات أكثر من 100 قضية فردية، تُسند إلى قاضٍ واحد في يوم واحد.

segments.src: Master calendar hearings are typically brief, administrative sessions where a judge confirms basic case information, addresses filing deadlines, and schedules the next stage of proceedings.
segments.tr: جلسات التقويم الرئيسية هي عادةً جلسات إدارية موجزة حيث يؤكد القاضي معلومات القضية الأساسية، ويتناول المواعيد النهائية لتقديم الطلبات، ويحدد المرحلة التالية من الإجراءات.

segments.src: They are not meant to resolve a case, but they are a required checkpoint in it.
segments.tr: لا يُقصد منها حل القضية، لكنها نقطة تفتيش مطلوبة فيها.

segments.src: When that checkpoint is stretched across a docket of 100-plus names, the math becomes difficult: even a few minutes per case, multiplied many times over, can push a single day's calendar well past standard court hours.
segments.tr: عندما يتم تمديد نقطة التفتيش هذه عبر جدول أعمال يضم أكثر من 100 اسم، تصبح الحسابات صعبة: حتى بضع دقائق لكل قضية، مضروبة في مرات عديدة، يمكن أن تدفع جدول أعمال يوم واحد إلى ما بعد ساعات المحكمة القياسية.

segments.src: ## Why the Dockets Have Grown
segments.tr: ## لماذا تضخمت جداول الأعمال

segments.src: Immigration courts nationwide have faced a mounting backlog of pending cases for years, a trend that predates any single administration and reflects a system that has long struggled to match staffing and courtroom capacity to caseload growth.
segments.tr: واجهت محاكم الهجرة في جميع أنحاء البلاد تراكمًا متزايدًا للقضايا المعلقة لسنوات، وهو اتجاه يسبق أي إدارة واحدة ويعكس نظامًا كافح طويلاً لمطابقة التوظيف وسعة قاعات المحكمة مع نمو عبء القضايا.

segments.src: Court administrators have described consolidated, high-volume dockets as one tool for moving cases forward more quickly and reducing the overall backlog.
segments.tr: وصف مسؤولو المحكمة جداول الأعمال الموحدة ذات الحجم الكبير بأنها أداة واحدة لتحريك القضايا إلى الأمام بسرعة أكبر وتقليل التراكم الإجمالي.

segments.src: Immigration attorneys, however, say the practical effect can cut the other way.
segments.tr: ومع ذلك، يقول محامو الهجرة إن التأثير العملي يمكن أن يكون عكس ذلك.

segments.src: With so many cases packed into one day, hearings are often rescheduled, delayed, or rushed, and it becomes harder for respondents — many of whom are unrepresented — to track exactly when their case will be called.
segments.tr: مع حشد العديد من القضايا في يوم واحد، غالبًا ما يتم إعادة جدولة جلسات الاستماع أو تأخيرها أو التعجيل بها، ويصبح من الصعب على المدعى عليهم - الذين لا يمثلهم محامون في كثير من الحالات - تتبع متى سيتم استدعاء قضيتهم بالضبط.

segments.src: Some attorneys report being assigned to appear for multiple clients scheduled at nearly the same time, forcing difficult choices about which hearing to prioritize.
segments.tr: يبلغ بعض المحامين عن تكليفهم بالمثول لعدة موكلين مجدولين في نفس الوقت تقريبًا، مما يضطرهم إلى اتخاذ خيارات صعبة بشأن جلسة الاستماع التي يجب إعطاؤها الأولوية.

segments.src: ## The Link to In-Absentia Orders
segments.tr: ## الرابط بأوامر الغياب

segments.src: One consequence that has drawn particular attention is a rise in in-absentia deportation orders — rulings issued when a respondent does not appear for a scheduled hearing.
segments.tr: إحدى العواقب التي جذبت اهتماماً خاصاً هي ارتفاع أوامر الترحيل الغيابية - وهي أحكام تصدر عندما لا يحضر المدعى عليه لجلسة استماع مجدولة.

segments.src: Nationally, these orders have reportedly climbed to among the highest levels on record in recent court data reviewed by legal aid organizations.
segments.tr: على الصعيد الوطني، أفادت التقارير أن هذه الأوامر ارتفعت إلى مستويات تعد من بين الأعلى على الإطلاق في بيانات المحكمة الأخيرة التي راجعتها منظمات المساعدة القانونية.

segments.src: Advocates argue that confusing notices, long courthouse lines, overcrowded dockets, and limited access to counsel can all contribute to missed hearings, particularly for people who are not fluent in English or lack reliable transportation and childcare.
segments.tr: يجادل المدافعون بأن الإخطارات المربكة، وطوابير المحكمة الطويلة، وجداول الأعمال المكتظة، ومحدودية الوصول إلى المحامين، كلها عوامل يمكن أن تساهم في ضياع جلسات الاستماع، خاصة للأشخاص الذين لا يجيدون اللغة الإنجليزية أو يفتقرون إلى وسائل النقل الموثوقة ورعاية الأطفال.

segments.src: Immigration law generally allows a judge to order removal in a person's absence if proper notice was given, and reopening such a case typically requires showing the absence was due to "exceptional circumstances."
segments.tr: يسمح قانون الهجرة عموماً للقاضي بأمر الترحيل في غياب الشخص إذا تم تقديم إشعار مناسب، وعادة ما يتطلب إعادة فتح مثل هذه القضية إثبات أن الغياب كان بسبب "ظروف استثنائية".

segments.src: Attorneys note that the bar for reopening can be difficult to meet, which raises the stakes of any hearing that goes uncalled or unattended due to scheduling congestion.
segments.tr: يشير المحامون إلى أن معيار إعادة الفتح قد يكون من الصعب استيفاؤه، مما يرفع من مخاطر أي جلسة استماع لا يتم استدعاؤها أو لا يتم حضورها بسبب ازدحام الجدولة.

segments.src: ## Life Outside the Courthouse
segments.tr: ## الحياة خارج المحكمة

segments.src: For many families, the burden begins well before a case is called.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للعديد من العائلات، يبدأ العبء قبل وقت طويل من استدعاء القضية.

segments.src: Waiting in line for hours, arranging time off work, and finding care for children are all part of a single hearing day — one that, under a packed docket, may end without a case being reached at all, requiring a return trip on another date.
segments.tr: الانتظار في الطابور لساعات، وترتيب إجازة من العمل، وإيجاد رعاية للأطفال، كلها جزء من يوم جلسة استماع واحدة - وهو يوم، في ظل جدول أعمال مكتظ، قد ينتهي دون الوصول إلى القضية على الإطلاق، مما يتطلب رحلة عودة في تاريخ آخر.

segments.src: Local legal aid groups say they have expanded morning outreach and know-your-rights information to help people understand check-in procedures and reduce the chance of an avoidable missed hearing.
segments.tr: تقول مجموعات المساعدة القانونية المحلية إنها وسعت نطاق التوعية الصباحية ومعلومات "اعرف حقوقك" لمساعدة الناس على فهم إجراءات تسجيل الحضور وتقليل فرصة ضياع جلسة استماع يمكن تجنبها.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## ماذا بعد

segments.src: Court officials have not detailed specific plans to cap the size of individual dockets, and the practice appears to reflect broader capacity pressures across the immigration court system rather than a policy unique to South Florida.
segments.tr: لم يحدد مسؤولو المحكمة خططاً محددة لوضع حد أقصى لحجم جداول الأعمال الفردية، ويبدو أن هذه الممارسة تعكس ضغوطاً أوسع على القدرات عبر نظام محاكم الهجرة بدلاً من كونها سياسة فريدة لجنوب فلوريدا.

segments.src: Legal observers say the situation in Miami is likely to be watched closely as a bellwether for how the courts balance the competing goals of reducing case backlogs and preserving each respondent's opportunity to be heard.
segments.tr: يقول المراقبون القانونيون إن الوضع في ميامي من المرجح أن تتم مراقبته عن كثب كمؤشر على كيفية موازنة المحاكم بين الأهداف المتنافسة المتمثلة في تقليل تراكم القضايا والحفاظ على فرصة كل مدعى عليه في أن يُسمع.

fr.title: 100 dossiers, un seul rôle : immersion dans les audiences « méga-master » qui submergent le tribunal de l'immigration de Miami

segments.src: ## A Courthouse Under Strain
segments.tr: ## Un tribunal sous tension

segments.src: Before sunrise on weekday mornings, lines now stretch outside the Miami immigration courthouse, with families and individuals waiting for hours just to check in for a hearing.
segments.tr: Avant le lever du soleil, en semaine, des files d'attente s'étirent désormais devant le tribunal de l'immigration de Miami, où familles et particuliers attendent des heures juste pour se présenter à une audience.

segments.src: Attorneys and court observers say the wait has become a routine part of navigating the system here, driven by a scheduling approach some in the legal community have nicknamed the "mega master" docket: dozens, and in some instances more than 100, individual cases assigned to a single judge on a single day.
segments.tr: Les avocats et les observateurs du tribunal affirment que cette attente est devenue une routine pour naviguer dans le système local, en raison d'une approche de planification que certains membres de la communauté juridique ont surnommée le rôle « méga-master » : des dizaines, et parfois plus de 100 dossiers individuels, assignés à un seul juge pour une seule journée.

segments.src: Master calendar hearings are typically brief, administrative sessions where a judge confirms basic case information, addresses filing deadlines, and schedules the next stage of proceedings.
segments.tr: Les audiences de mise en état (master calendar hearings) sont généralement de brèves sessions administratives où un juge confirme les informations de base du dossier, traite les délais de dépôt et planifie la prochaine étape de la procédure.

segments.src: They are not meant to resolve a case, but they are a required checkpoint in it.
segments.tr: Elles ne sont pas destinées à résoudre une affaire, mais constituent un point de contrôle obligatoire.

segments.src: When that checkpoint is stretched across a docket of 100-plus names, the math becomes difficult: even a few minutes per case, multiplied many times over, can push a single day's calendar well past standard court hours.
segments.tr: Lorsque ce point de contrôle est étendu à un rôle de plus de 100 noms, le calcul devient difficile : même quelques minutes par dossier, multipliées à maintes reprises, peuvent pousser le calendrier d'une seule journée bien au-delà des heures d'ouverture habituelles du tribunal.

segments.src: ## Why the Dockets Have Grown
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les rôles ont grossi

segments.src: Immigration courts nationwide have faced a mounting backlog of pending cases for years, a trend that predates any single administration and reflects a system that has long struggled to match staffing and courtroom capacity to caseload growth.
segments.tr: Les tribunaux de l'immigration à l'échelle nationale font face à un arriéré croissant d'affaires en instance depuis des années, une tendance qui précède toute administration particulière et reflète un système qui peine depuis longtemps à adapter ses effectifs et sa capacité d'accueil à la croissance du nombre de dossiers.

segments.src: Court administrators have described consolidated, high-volume dockets as one tool for moving cases forward more quickly and reducing the overall backlog.
segments.tr: Les administrateurs des tribunaux ont décrit les rôles consolidés à haut volume comme un outil permettant de faire avancer les dossiers plus rapidement et de réduire l'arriéré global.

segments.src: Immigration attorneys, however, say the practical effect can cut the other way.
segments.tr: Les avocats spécialisés en immigration, cependant, affirment que l'effet pratique peut être inverse.

segments.src: With so many cases packed into one day, hearings are often rescheduled, delayed, or rushed, and it becomes harder for respondents — many of whom are unrepresented — to track exactly when their case will be called.
segments.tr: Avec autant de dossiers regroupés sur une seule journée, les audiences sont souvent reprogrammées, retardées ou précipitées, et il devient plus difficile pour les justiciables — dont beaucoup ne sont pas représentés — de savoir exactement quand leur dossier sera appelé.

segments.src: Some attorneys report being assigned to appear for multiple clients scheduled at nearly the same time, forcing difficult choices about which hearing to prioritize.
segments.tr: Certains avocats rapportent avoir été assignés à comparaître pour plusieurs clients programmés presque en même temps, ce qui les force à faire des choix difficiles sur l'audience à prioriser.

segments.src: ## The Link to In-Absentia Orders
segments.tr: ## Le lien avec les ordonnances par défaut

segments.src: One consequence that has drawn particular attention is a rise in in-absentia deportation orders — rulings issued when a respondent does not appear for a scheduled hearing.
segments.tr: Une conséquence qui a particulièrement attiré l'attention est l'augmentation des ordonnances d'expulsion par défaut (in-absentia) — des décisions rendues lorsqu'un justiciable ne se présente pas à une audience programmée.

segments.src: Nationally, these orders have reportedly climbed to among the highest levels on record in recent court data reviewed by legal aid organizations.
segments.tr: À l'échelle nationale, ces ordonnances auraient atteint l'un des niveaux les plus élevés jamais enregistrés selon les récentes données judiciaires examinées par des organisations d'aide juridique.

segments.src: Advocates argue that confusing notices, long courthouse lines, overcrowded dockets, and limited access to counsel can all contribute to missed hearings, particularly for people who are not fluent in English or lack reliable transportation and childcare.
segments.tr: Les défenseurs soutiennent que les avis confus, les longues files d'attente au tribunal, les rôles surchargés et l'accès limité à un avocat peuvent tous contribuer aux absences aux audiences, en particulier pour les personnes qui ne maîtrisent pas l'anglais ou qui manquent de moyens de transport fiables et de solutions de garde d'enfants.

segments.src: Immigration law generally allows a judge to order removal in a person's absence if proper notice was given, and reopening such a case typically requires showing the absence was due to "exceptional circumstances."
segments.tr: Le droit de l'immigration permet généralement à un juge d'ordonner l'expulsion en l'absence d'une personne si un avis approprié a été donné, et la réouverture d'un tel dossier nécessite généralement de démontrer que l'absence était due à des « circonstances exceptionnelles ».

segments.src: Attorneys note that the bar for reopening can be difficult to meet, which raises the stakes of any hearing that goes uncalled or unattended due to scheduling congestion.
segments.tr: Les avocats notent que la barre pour obtenir une réouverture peut être difficile à atteindre, ce qui augmente les enjeux de toute audience qui n'est pas appelée ou à laquelle personne ne se présente en raison de l'encombrement du calendrier.

segments.src: ## Life Outside the Courthouse
segments.tr: ## La vie en dehors du tribunal

segments.src: For many families, the burden begins well before a case is called.
segments.tr: Pour de nombreuses familles, le fardeau commence bien avant que le dossier ne soit appelé.

segments.src: Waiting in line for hours, arranging time off work, and finding care for children are all part of a single hearing day — one that, under a packed docket, may end without a case being reached at all, requiring a return trip on another date.
segments.tr: Attendre des heures dans la file, prendre des congés au travail et trouver une garde pour les enfants font tous partie d'une seule journée d'audience — une journée qui, avec un rôle surchargé, peut se terminer sans que le dossier ne soit jamais traité, nécessitant un voyage de retour à une autre date.

segments.src: Local legal aid groups say they have expanded morning outreach and know-your-rights information to help people understand check-in procedures and reduce the chance of an avoidable missed hearing.
segments.tr: Les groupes d'aide juridique locaux affirment avoir élargi leurs actions de sensibilisation matinales et leurs informations sur les droits pour aider les gens à comprendre les procédures d'enregistrement et réduire les risques d'absence évitable à une audience.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Quelles sont les prochaines étapes

segments.src: Court officials have not detailed specific plans to cap the size of individual dockets, and the practice appears to reflect broader capacity pressures across the immigration court system rather than a policy unique to South Florida.
segments.tr: Les responsables des tribunaux n'ont pas détaillé de plans spécifiques pour plafonner la taille des rôles individuels, et cette pratique semble refléter des pressions de capacité plus larges dans l'ensemble du système des tribunaux de l'immigration plutôt qu'une politique propre au sud de la Floride.

segments.src: Legal observers say the situation in Miami is likely to be watched closely as a bellwether for how the courts balance the competing goals of reducing case backlogs and preserving each respondent's opportunity to be heard.
segments.tr: Les observateurs juridiques affirment que la situation à Miami sera probablement suivie de près comme un indicateur de la manière dont les tribunaux équilibrent les objectifs concurrents de réduction des arriérés de dossiers et de préservation de l'opportunité pour chaque justiciable d'être entendu.

segments.src: *This report is based on publicly available court information and accounts from immigration attorneys and legal aid organizations.
segments.tr: *Ce rapport est basé sur des informations judiciaires accessibles au public et sur les témoignages d'avocats spécialisés en immigration et d'organisations d'aide juridique.

segments.tr: Les résultats des dossiers individuels varient, et les lecteurs ayant une affaire d'immigration en instance devraient consulter un avocat qualifié ou un représentant accrédité pour obtenir des conseils spécifiques à leur situation.*

in.title: 100 Kasus, Satu Daftar Perkara: Di Dalam Sidang "Mega Master" yang Membebani Pengadilan Imigrasi Miami

segments.src: ## A Courthouse Under Strain
segments.tr: ## Pengadilan di Bawah Tekanan

segments.src: Before sunrise on weekday mornings, lines now stretch outside the Miami immigration courthouse, with families and individuals waiting for hours just to check in for a hearing.
segments.tr: Sebelum matahari terbit pada hari kerja, antrean kini mengular di luar gedung pengadilan imigrasi Miami, dengan keluarga dan individu menunggu selama berjam-jam hanya untuk melapor (check-in) untuk sidang.

segments.src: Attorneys and court observers say the wait has become a routine part of navigating the system here, driven by a scheduling approach some in the legal community have nicknamed the "mega master" docket: dozens, and in some instances more than 100, individual cases assigned to a single judge on a single day.
segments.tr: Para pengacara dan pengamat pengadilan mengatakan waktu tunggu telah menjadi bagian rutin dari menavigasi sistem di sini, didorong oleh pendekatan penjadwalan yang dijuluki oleh beberapa orang di komunitas hukum sebagai daftar perkara "mega master": puluhan, dan dalam beberapa kasus lebih dari 100, kasus individual yang ditugaskan ke satu hakim dalam satu hari.

segments.src: Master calendar hearings are typically brief, administrative sessions where a judge confirms basic case information, addresses filing deadlines, and schedules the next stage of proceedings.
segments.tr: Sidang kalender utama (master calendar) biasanya merupakan sesi administratif singkat di mana seorang hakim mengonfirmasi informasi dasar kasus, menangani tenggat waktu pengajuan, dan menjadwalkan tahap persidangan berikutnya.

segments.src: They are not meant to resolve a case, but they are a required checkpoint in it.
segments.tr: Sidang tersebut tidak dimaksudkan untuk menyelesaikan kasus, tetapi merupakan pos pemeriksaan (checkpoint) yang wajib dalam kasus tersebut.

segments.src: When that checkpoint is stretched across a docket of 100-plus names, the math becomes difficult: even a few minutes per case, multiplied many times over, can push a single day's calendar well past standard court hours.
segments.tr: Ketika pos pemeriksaan itu direntangkan di seluruh daftar yang berisi lebih dari 100 nama, perhitungannya menjadi sulit: bahkan beberapa menit per kasus, dikalikan berkali-kali, dapat mendorong kalender satu hari melewati jam kerja pengadilan standar.

segments.src: ## Why the Dockets Have Grown
segments.tr: ## Mengapa Daftar Perkara Bertambah

segments.src: Immigration courts nationwide have faced a mounting backlog of pending cases for years, a trend that predates any single administration and reflects a system that has long struggled to match staffing and courtroom capacity to caseload growth.
segments.tr: Pengadilan imigrasi di seluruh negeri telah menghadapi peningkatan tunggakan kasus yang tertunda selama bertahun-tahun, sebuah tren yang terjadi sebelum pemerintahan manapun dan mencerminkan sistem yang telah lama berjuang untuk mencocokkan staf dan kapasitas ruang sidang dengan pertumbuhan beban kasus.

segments.src: Court administrators have described consolidated, high-volume dockets as one tool for moving cases forward more quickly and reducing the overall backlog.
segments.tr: Para administrator pengadilan telah mendeskripsikan daftar perkara bervolume tinggi yang dikonsolidasikan sebagai salah satu alat untuk memajukan kasus lebih cepat dan mengurangi keseluruhan tunggakan.

segments.src: Immigration attorneys, however, say the practical effect can cut the other way.
segments.tr: Namun, para pengacara imigrasi mengatakan efek praktisnya bisa sebaliknya.

segments.src: With so many cases packed into one day, hearings are often rescheduled, delayed, or rushed, and it becomes harder for respondents — many of whom are unrepresented — to track exactly when their case will be called.
segments.tr: Dengan begitu banyak kasus yang dipadatkan dalam satu hari, sidang sering kali dijadwal ulang, ditunda, atau dipercepat, dan menjadi lebih sulit bagi para responden — yang banyak di antaranya tidak diwakili oleh pengacara — untuk melacak secara persis kapan kasus mereka akan dipanggil.

segments.src: Some attorneys report being assigned to appear for multiple clients scheduled at nearly the same time, forcing difficult choices about which hearing to prioritize.
segments.tr: Beberapa pengacara melaporkan ditugaskan untuk hadir bagi beberapa klien yang dijadwalkan pada waktu yang hampir bersamaan, memaksa mereka membuat pilihan sulit tentang sidang mana yang harus diprioritaskan.

segments.src: ## The Link to In-Absentia Orders
segments.tr: ## Kaitan dengan Putusan In-Absentia

segments.src: One consequence that has drawn particular attention is a rise in in-absentia deportation orders — rulings issued when a respondent does not appear for a scheduled hearing.
segments.tr: Salah satu konsekuensi yang menarik perhatian khusus adalah peningkatan perintah deportasi in-absentia — putusan yang dikeluarkan ketika seorang responden tidak hadir untuk sidang yang dijadwalkan.

segments.src: Nationally, these orders have reportedly climbed to among the highest levels on record in recent court data reviewed by legal aid organizations.
segments.tr: Secara nasional, perintah ini dilaporkan telah naik ke tingkat tertinggi yang pernah tercatat dalam data pengadilan baru-baru ini yang ditinjau oleh organisasi bantuan hukum.

segments.src: Advocates argue that confusing notices, long courthouse lines, overcrowded dockets, and limited access to counsel can all contribute to missed hearings, particularly for people who are not fluent in English or lack reliable transportation and childcare.
segments.tr: Para advokat berpendapat bahwa pemberitahuan yang membingungkan, antrean pengadilan yang panjang, daftar perkara yang terlalu padat, dan akses terbatas ke penasihat hukum semuanya dapat berkontribusi pada keterlewatannya sidang, terutama bagi orang-orang yang tidak lancar berbahasa Inggris atau kekurangan transportasi yang andal dan penitipan anak.

segments.src: Immigration law generally allows a judge to order removal in a person's absence if proper notice was given, and reopening such a case typically requires showing the absence was due to "exceptional circumstances."
segments.tr: Hukum imigrasi umumnya mengizinkan hakim untuk memerintahkan pengusiran (removal) tanpa kehadiran seseorang jika pemberitahuan yang tepat telah diberikan, dan membuka kembali kasus semacam itu biasanya memerlukan pembuktian bahwa ketidakhadiran tersebut disebabkan oleh "keadaan luar biasa."

segments.src: Attorneys note that the bar for reopening can be difficult to meet, which raises the stakes of any hearing that goes uncalled or unattended due to scheduling congestion.
segments.tr: Para pengacara mencatat bahwa ambang batas untuk pembukaan kembali kasus bisa sulit dipenuhi, yang meningkatkan taruhan dari setiap sidang yang tidak dipanggil atau tidak dihadiri karena kepadatan penjadwalan.

segments.src: ## Life Outside the Courthouse
segments.tr: ## Kehidupan di Luar Gedung Pengadilan

segments.src: For many families, the burden begins well before a case is called.
segments.tr: Bagi banyak keluarga, beban dimulai jauh sebelum sebuah kasus dipanggil.

segments.src: Waiting in line for hours, arranging time off work, and finding care for children are all part of a single hearing day — one that, under a packed docket, may end without a case being reached at all, requiring a return trip on another date.
segments.tr: Menunggu dalam antrean selama berjam-jam, mengatur izin kerja, dan mencari pengasuh untuk anak-anak adalah bagian dari satu hari sidang — yang, di bawah daftar perkara yang padat, dapat berakhir tanpa kasus tersebut sempat disidangkan sama sekali, yang memerlukan perjalanan kembali pada tanggal lain.

segments.src: Local legal aid groups say they have expanded morning outreach and know-your-rights information to help people understand check-in procedures and reduce the chance of an avoidable missed hearing.
segments.tr: Kelompok bantuan hukum lokal mengatakan mereka telah memperluas penjangkauan pagi dan informasi hak-hak Anda untuk membantu orang memahami prosedur pelaporan dan mengurangi kemungkinan terlewatnya sidang yang dapat dihindari.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
segments.tr: ## Apa Selanjutnya

segments.src: Court officials have not detailed specific plans to cap the size of individual dockets, and the practice appears to reflect broader capacity pressures across the immigration court system rather than a policy unique to South Florida.
segments.tr: Para pejabat pengadilan belum merinci rencana spesifik untuk membatasi ukuran daftar perkara individual, dan praktik tersebut tampaknya mencerminkan tekanan kapasitas yang lebih luas di seluruh sistem pengadilan imigrasi daripada kebijakan yang unik untuk Florida Selatan.

segments.src: Legal observers say the situation in Miami is likely to be watched closely as a bellwether for how the courts balance the competing goals of reducing case backlogs and preserving each respondent's opportunity to be heard.
segments.tr: Para pengamat hukum mengatakan situasi di Miami kemungkinan akan diawasi secara ketat sebagai indikator utama tentang bagaimana pengadilan menyeimbangkan tujuan yang bersaing antara mengurangi tunggakan kasus dan mempertahankan kesempatan setiap responden untuk didengar.

segments.src: *This report is based on publicly available court information and accounts from immigration attorneys and legal aid organizations.
segments.tr: *Laporan ini didasarkan pada informasi pengadilan yang tersedia untuk umum dan keterangan dari pengacara imigrasi serta organisasi bantuan hukum.

segments.src: ## A Courthouse Under Strain
segments.tr: ## プレッシャーにさらされる裁判所

segments.src: Before sunrise on weekday mornings, lines now stretch outside the Miami immigration courthouse, with families and individuals waiting for hours just to check in for a hearing.

segments.src: They are not meant to resolve a case, but they are a required checkpoint in it.
segments.tr: これらは事件を解決するためのものではないが、不可欠なチェックポイントである。

segments.src: When that checkpoint is stretched across a docket of 100-plus names, the math becomes difficult: even a few minutes per case, multiplied many times over, can push a single day's calendar well past standard court hours.
segments.tr: そのチェックポイントが100件以上の名前が並ぶドケットに引き伸ばされると、計算は難しくなる。1件あたりわずか数分であっても、それが何度も積み重なれば、1日のカレンダーは通常の裁判時間を大幅に超えてしまう。

segments.src: ## Why the Dockets Have Grown
segments.tr: ## ドケットが増加した理由

segments.src: Court administrators have described consolidated, high-volume dockets as one tool for moving cases forward more quickly and reducing the overall backlog.

segments.src: Immigration attorneys, however, say the practical effect can cut the other way.

segments.src: With so many cases packed into one day, hearings are often rescheduled, delayed, or rushed, and it becomes harder for respondents — many of whom are unrepresented — to track exactly when their case will be called.
segments.tr: 1日に非常に多くのケースが詰め込まれるため、ヒアリングのスケジュール変更、遅延、または急ぎ足での処理が頻発し、弁護士を持たない人が多い当事者（レスポンダント）にとって、自分のケースがいつ呼ばれるのかを正確に把握することがより困難になっている。

segments.src: Some attorneys report being assigned to appear for multiple clients scheduled at nearly the same time, forcing difficult choices about which hearing to prioritize.
segments.tr: 一部の弁護士からは、ほぼ同じ時間に予定されている複数のクライアントのために出頭を割り当てられ、どのヒアリングを優先すべきかという難しい選択を迫られているという報告が寄せられている。

segments.src: ## The Link to In-Absentia Orders
segments.tr: ## 不出頭（イン・アブセンティア）命令との関連

segments.src: Nationally, these orders have reportedly climbed to among the highest levels on record in recent court data reviewed by legal aid organizations.
segments.tr: 法支援団体が検討した最近の裁判所のデータによると、全国的にこれらの命令は記録的な高水準にまで上昇していると報じられている。

segments.src: Advocates argue that confusing notices, long courthouse lines, overcrowded dockets, and limited access to counsel can all contribute to missed hearings, particularly for people who are not fluent in English or lack reliable transportation and childcare.

segments.src: Immigration law generally allows a judge to order removal in a person's absence if proper notice was given, and reopening such a case typically requires showing the absence was due to "exceptional circumstances."
segments.tr: 入管法では通常、適切な通知が行われていた場合、本人の不在時に退去強制を命じることを裁判官に認めており、そのようなケースを再開するには通常、不在が「例外的な状況」によるものであったことを示す必要がある。

segments.src: Attorneys note that the bar for reopening can be difficult to meet, which raises the stakes of any hearing that goes uncalled or unattended due to scheduling congestion.
segments.tr: 弁護士らは、再開のためのハードルは満たすのが難しい場合があり、スケジュールが混み合っているために呼び出されなかったり出席できなかったりするヒアリングのリスクを高めていると指摘している。

segments.src: ## Life Outside the Courthouse
segments.tr: ## 裁判所の外での生活

segments.src: For many families, the burden begins well before a case is called.

segments.src: Waiting in line for hours, arranging time off work, and finding care for children are all part of a single hearing day — one that, under a packed docket, may end without a case being reached at all, requiring a return trip on another date.

segments.src: ## What Comes Next
